7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

10:   const stars = [];

14:       y: Math.random() * height,

16:     });

19:   // ----- game objects -----

24:   let gameOver = false;
25: 
26:   // ----- audio setup -----
27:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
28:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
29:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
30:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
31:     osc.type = 'triangle';
32:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
37:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
38:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
39:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
40:   };
41:   const playLaser = () => playTone(600, 100);
42:   const playExplosion = () => playTone(150, 300);
43:   const playGameOver = () => playTone(80, 500);
44: 
45:   // ----- input handling -----
46:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
47:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') left = true;

51:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
52:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') left = false;
53:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') right = false;
54:     if (e.code === 'Space') fire = false;
55:   });

57:   // ----- helpers -----
58:   const rectCollide = (a, b) =>

61:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
62:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
63:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
64:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
65:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed });
66:   };
67: 
68:   // ----- main loop -----
69:   let lastSpawn = 0;
70:   function update(dt) {

72: 
73:     // ship movement
74:     if (left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
75:     if (right) ship.x += ship.speed;
76:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
77: 
78:     // fire lasers
79:     if (fire) {
80:       // limit fire rate

82:         lasers.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 2, y: ship.y, w: 4, h: 10, speed: 7 });
83:         ship.lastShot = Date.now();

88:     // update lasers

92:       if (lasers[i].y + lasers[i].h < 0) lasers.splice(i, 1);

100: 
101:     // update asteroids

103: 
104:     // collisions: laser‑asteroid

109:         // asteroid reaches bottom?
